The region values in raw_customers have trailing whitespace ('SOUTH ', 'WEST ', 'NORTH ', 'EAST '). The current step only applies upper(), so silver_customers carries the untrimmed values, and gold_region_daily splits each region into two groups.

Trimming is safe because the correct mapping is unambiguous: 'SOUTH ' is SOUTH. After trimming there are exactly four distinct regions, and customer_id is unique (200 distinct in 200 rows), so the join does not fan out.

I considered other possible problems and found nothing that needs action:
- Reversed transactions are filtered out by status = 'POSTED', which looks intentional.
- Transaction ids are unique (4866 distinct in 4866 rows), so there are no duplicate deliveries.
- Batches 1 to 14 are all present.

Only silver_customers needs replacing. gold_region_daily reads from it, so it is rebuilt correctly on the next run.
